001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.disruptor;
002
003import java.util.Collection;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
006import java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory;
007import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
008import java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport;
009
010import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import com.lmax.disruptor.BlockingWaitStrategy;
013import com.lmax.disruptor.EventHandler;
014import com.lmax.disruptor.ExceptionHandler;
015import com.lmax.disruptor.InsufficientCapacityException;
016import com.lmax.disruptor.RingBuffer;
017import com.lmax.disruptor.TimeoutException;
018import com.lmax.disruptor.dsl.Disruptor;
019import com.lmax.disruptor.dsl.ProducerType;
020import com.lmax.disruptor.util.DaemonThreadFactory;
021
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender;
024import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
025import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
026import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher;
027import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisherRegistry;
028import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher;
029import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender.Appenders;
030
031/**
032 * Disruptor async publisher. Like the default async publisher it starts and closes its
033 * appenders, and closing drains the events already published, waiting at most
034 * {@value LogPublisherRegistry#ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT} ms. Start returns once the
035 * consumer threads are running, waiting at most as long. Events logged after close are
036 * dropped. Calling start more than once while running is harmless; a closed or failed
037 * publisher cannot be restarted. Events logged before start are dropped.
038 */
039public final class DisruptorLogPublisher implements AsyncLogPublisher {
040
041        private final Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor;
042
043        private final RingBuffer<LogEventCell> ringBuffer;
044
045        private final List<? extends LogAppender> appenders;
046
047        private final LogAlerts alerts;
048
049        /*
050         * Disruptor's shutdown skips a consumer whose thread has not run yet, and the
051         * consumer then exits without reading the ring, so close right after start would drop
052         * the events in it.
053         */
054        private final CountDownLatch consumersRunning;
055
056        private final Object lifecycle = new Object();
057
058        private volatile State state = State.NEW;
059
060        private enum State {
061
062                NEW, STARTING, RUNNING, CLOSED
063
064        }
065
066        /**
067         * Creates a factory of disruptor log publishers.
068         * @param bufferSize ring buffer size.
069         * @return factory to generate this class.
070         */
071        public static PublisherFactory of(int bufferSize) {
072                return new PublisherFactory() {
073                        @Override
074                        public LogPublisher create(String name, LogConfig config, Appenders appenders) {
075                                return of(appenders.asList(), DaemonThreadFactory.INSTANCE, bufferSize, config.alerts());
076                        }
077                };
078        }
079
080        /**
081         * Creates.
082         * @param appenders appenders.
083         * @param threadFactory thread factory to create writer thread.
084         * @param bufferSize maximum queue elements.
085         * @param alerts alerts for reporting internal errors (disruptor exception handler
086         * failures).
087         * @return publisher.
088         */
089        public static DisruptorLogPublisher of(Collection<? extends LogAppender> appenders, ThreadFactory threadFactory,
090                        int bufferSize, LogAlerts alerts) {
091
092                if (appenders.isEmpty()) {
093                        throw new IllegalStateException();
094                }
095                Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor = new Disruptor<>(LogEventCell::new, bufferSize, threadFactory,
096                                ProducerType.MULTI, new BlockingWaitStrategy());
097                var consumersRunning = new CountDownLatch(appenders.size());
098                var router = new DisruptorLogPublisher(disruptor, disruptor.getRingBuffer(), List.copyOf(appenders), alerts,
099                                consumersRunning);
100                disruptor.setDefaultExceptionHandler(new LogExceptionHandler(router));
101
102                for (var appender : appenders) {
103                        disruptor.handleEventsWith(new LogEventHandler(appender, consumersRunning));
104                }
105
106                return router;
107        }
108
109        @Override
110        public void start(LogConfig config) {
111                synchronized (lifecycle) {
112                        if (state == State.RUNNING) {
113                                return;
114                        }
115                        if (state != State.NEW) {
116                                throw new IllegalStateException("DisruptorLogPublisher cannot be restarted.");
117                        }
118                        state = State.STARTING;
119                        int started = 0;
120                        try {
121                                for (var appender : appenders) {
122                                        // A failed start may already have opened an output resource.
123                                        started++;
124                                        appender.start(config);
125                                }
126                                disruptor.start();
127                                awaitConsumers();
128                                state = State.RUNNING;
129                        }
130                        catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
131                                state = State.CLOSED;
132                                // A thread factory may fail after starting an earlier consumer.
133                                disruptor.halt();
134                                for (var appender : appenders.subList(0, started)) {
135                                        // See doc/checker-framework-bugs.md for try-with-resources.
136                                        try (appender) {
137                                        }
138                                        catch (RuntimeException | Error closeFailure) {
139                                                e.addSuppressed(closeFailure);
140                                        }
141                                }
142                                throw e;
143                        }
144                }
145        }
146
147        private void awaitConsumers() {
148                try {
149                        if (!consumersRunning.await(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) {
150                                throw new IllegalStateException("Disruptor consumer threads did not start within "
151                                                + LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT + " ms");
152                        }
153                }
154                catch (InterruptedException e) {
155                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
156                        throw new IllegalStateException("Interrupted waiting for disruptor consumer threads to start", e);
157                }
158        }
159
160        private DisruptorLogPublisher(Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor, RingBuffer<LogEventCell> ringBuffer,
161                        List<? extends LogAppender> appenders, LogAlerts alerts, CountDownLatch consumersRunning) {
162                super();
163                this.disruptor = disruptor;
164                this.ringBuffer = ringBuffer;
165                this.appenders = appenders;
166                this.alerts = alerts;
167                this.consumersRunning = consumersRunning;
168        }
169
170        @Override
171        public void log(LogEvent event) {
172                while (state == State.RUNNING) {
173                        try {
174                                synchronized (lifecycle) {
175                                        if (state != State.RUNNING) {
176                                                return;
177                                        }
178                                        // Claim and publish before close can begin draining. Never wait
179                                        // for capacity while holding the lifecycle monitor.
180                                        long sequence = ringBuffer.tryNext();
181                                        try {
182                                                ringBuffer.get(sequence).event = event;
183                                        }
184                                        finally {
185                                                ringBuffer.publish(sequence);
186                                        }
187                                        return;
188                                }
189                        }
190                        catch (InsufficientCapacityException e) {
191                                // As in Disruptor's blocking claim, wait briefly for capacity,
192                                // but also observe shutdown so no producer is left stranded.
193                                LockSupport.parkNanos(1);
194                        }
195                }
196        }
197
198        @Override
199        public void close() {
200                synchronized (lifecycle) {
201                        if (state == State.CLOSED) {
202                                return;
203                        }
204                        state = State.CLOSED;
205                }
206                try {
207                        disruptor.shutdown(LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
208                }
209                catch (TimeoutException e) {
210                        alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, "Disruptor did not drain within "
211                                        + LogPublisherRegistry.ASYNC_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT + " ms; remaining events are dropped", e);
212                        disruptor.halt();
213                }
214                for (var appender : appenders) {
215                        try (appender) {
216                        }
217                        catch (RuntimeException | Error e) {
218                                alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, "Failed to close appender", e);
219                        }
220                }
221        }
222
223        @Override
224        public String toString() {
225                return super.toString() + "[appenders=" + this.appenders + "]";
226        }
227
228        private static class LogEventCell {
229
230                @Nullable LogEvent event;
231
232        }
233
234        private static record LogEventHandler(LogAppender appender,
235                        CountDownLatch consumersRunning) implements EventHandler<LogEventCell> {
236
237                @Override
238                public void onStart() {
239                        // Called once the consumer counts as running for shutdown.
240                        consumersRunning.countDown();
241                }
242
243                @Override
244                public void onEvent(LogEventCell event, long sequence, boolean endOfBatch) throws Exception {
245                        var logEvent = event.event;
246                        if (logEvent == null) {
247                                return;
248                        }
249                        appender.append(logEvent);
250                }
251
252        }
253
254        /*
255         * Rethrowing would stop the consumer thread, and every producer would then block once
256         * the ring is full, so a failed event is reported and the consumer carries on.
257         */
258        private record LogExceptionHandler(DisruptorLogPublisher publisher) implements ExceptionHandler<Object> {
259
260                @Override
261                public void handleEventException(Throwable ex, long sequence, Object event) {
262                        publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
263                }
264
265                @Override
266                public void handleOnStartException(Throwable ex) {
267                        publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
268                }
269
270                @Override
271                public void handleOnShutdownException(Throwable ex) {
272                        publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
273                }
274
275        }
276
277}
